title: Renting a sewing machine from the library
summary: This BBC Future article explores Finland's innovative library system where citizens can borrow unusual items like sewing machines, tools, and other everyday objects, not just books, as part of a broader movement toward community sharing and sustainability.
problem_solved: Addresses underutilization of rarely-needed but expensive items and promotes sustainable sharing within local communities.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how libraries can evolve beyond books to become community resource hubs that reduce consumption and increase access to tools for everyone.
